🔥 roxum-ide | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a fully-featured Integrated Development Environment (IDE) on Android devices, enabling mobile coding, debugging, and development workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Flutter-based mobile IDE for Android • Built-in Termux support • Offline GGUF LLM model support for chat and code completion • Offline compilers and extensions for popular languages • 245 built-in themes and custom theme creation
📖 Summary: Roxum IDE is a Flutter-based mobile IDE for Android, offering a comprehensive suite of tools for code editing, terminal workflows, and AI assistance. It aims to provide a powerful and customizable development environment directly on mobile devices.
